title: Acquirer: Orica Australia Pty Ltd; Target: Huntsman Chemical Company Australia Pty Ltd
targets: Huntsman Chemical Company Australia Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Orica Australia Limited seeks to acquire the phenolic resins buisness of Huntsman Chemical Company Pty Ltd
body_sections.Market definition: The national market for formaldehyde based resins.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC decided not to oppose the Orica's acquisition of Huntsman on the grounds that: * Huntsman only supplies phenolic resins (as opposed to amino resins) which constitute less than 10% of the formaldehyde based resins market; * Borden and Orica will remain strong competitors in the supply of amino and phenolic resins, and Woodchem and Dynea will also remain competitors in the supply of amino resins; and * Bariers to entry do not appear to be high in the industry, as evidenced by the successful entry of Woodchem in 2000.
